title: Duck Mod Extras
description: A data/resourcepack demonstrating how to add variants to Duck Mod
body:
# Duck Mod Extras
This is a demonstration datapack and resourcepack that adds a new duck variant for [Duck Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/mcduckmod), which repurposes ideas and textures cut from the mod. 

It includes a new chicken variant, the MC:Earth midnight chicken, to highlight the difference between setting up a chicken variant and a duck variant.   
The resourcepack also contains a texture for an unused Black Egg item.



## Notes
If any bugs are encountered, please report them directly to me on Discord at 'watchernovius'. Suggestions, improvements, and bugfixes are welcome.
